column1: # The cases of duckdb_cases.tsv the engine refuses where DuckDB answers:
# the SQL, a tab, and why. test_nan.cpp fails on a refusal not listed here
# and on a listed case the engine answers.
SELECT id FROM t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.d = t.d)
column2: a correlated subquery in WHERE EXISTS is not bound (the outer table is not in scope)

column1: SELECT g, sum(r) FROM (SELECT g, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY d, id) AS r FROM big QUALIFY r <= 10) GROUP BY g
column2: QUALIFY does not see a select-list alias
DuckDB reads text with a fraction as a number and rounds it; the engine does not (a NULL under TRY_CAST was a wrong answer)
